[[Sprite Spring]] |Time = Any time |Season = {{Season|All}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 80 |Behavior = Sinker |Size = 24 - 36 |XP = |Edibility = -20 |base = 175 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught in the [[Junimo Woods]] and in [[Sprite Spring]] in any season, time, and weather. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Junimo Woods.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Sprite Spring.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Junimo Woods - Fish Zone || style="text-align:center;"|Sprite Spring - Fishing Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love=Krobus |like=Wizard |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Linus, Pam, Sebastian, Willy |hate=Evelyn, Haley, Martin, Pierre, Sophia }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Meteor Carp}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|purple}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a purple color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:流星鲤鱼]]
